scope: Research recommendations ONLY: 33 eligible NFL tight ends, no present grades or runtime shared data changed
yearInterpretation: Baseline odds proposed for next offseason (Year 2); Year 3 recalculates conditional odds using realized Year 2 result and individual baseline within existing engine, not a second identical unconditional draw.
method: 2025 full-season and completed 2026 Week-4 official NFL individual receiving check, locked Oct 3 HQ graded role evidence, Oct 5 contract/draft context, and dated health/usage reporting for relevant cases. Individual game-design probability assessments are subjective, not statistically proven.
limitations: Per-player published advanced route, target, snap, PFF and block-grade evidence was not accessible/verified for all 33; no unverified precision used.
Live NFL career tables have no publication date; all were checked as of Oct 8 and the URL is retained for each player.
Some players have fewer than four 2026 appearances; absences are not automatically labeled injuries.
Current HQ grade values remain locked; development odds cannot serve as ability reratings.
The sole integration owner must decide whether and how to apply recommendations to shared authority.
